target.title: fix(memory-wiki): harden bridge imports under concurrent syncs
target.body:
## Summary

- Add bounded retry handling for transient `FsSafeError: path-mismatch` while writing imported memory-wiki source pages.
- Coalesce concurrent bridge imported-source syncs for the same resolved vault/config so `wiki.status`, `wiki.importInsights`, and `wiki.palace` share the same in-flight bridge sync instead of launching duplicate import/index-refresh passes.
- Preserve existing vault safety boundaries for symlink/path-alias and directory-collision cases.
- Merge current `origin/main`, keep main's shared guarded page-write path, and retain this PR's imported-source retry plus bridge sync coalescing behavior.
- **What did NOT change:** Out of scope and unchanged: no channel delivery, provider routing, plugin-hook contract, gateway method signature, config schema/default, broad session model change, or third-party provider behavior change.
- Why it matters / User impact: concurrent memory-wiki bridge imports no longer duplicate expensive import passes or fail the bridge surface on transient filesystem `path-mismatch` races, without weakening path safety.

Related to #91154.

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:**
```text
Bridge-mode memory-wiki imported-source sync must run through the real OpenClaw gateway surface for `wiki.status`, `wiki.importInsights`, and `wiki.palace`; concurrent bridge calls for the same vault/config should coalesce to one underlying bridge ingest/index-refresh pass; source-page rewrite pressure should not break the gateway or leave the bridge vault inconsistent.
```

- **Real environment tested:**
```text
Linux worktree: /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-worktrees/pr-91828
Evidence directory: /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-pr-91828-evidence
Current PR HEAD: 0aa26737dafd823a4d22d8e1046f8cb4780b2928
Current origin/main: 04e4c3719de3c4e558fa62314861932d09e5778d

Runtime used an isolated loopback OpenClaw gateway with:
OPENCLAW_HOME=/tmp/openclaw-pr91828-runtime-none/home
OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR=/tmp/openclaw-pr91828-runtime-none/state
OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH=/tmp/openclaw-pr91828-runtime-none/state/openclaw.json

memory-wiki was configured in bridge mode with `bridge.readMemoryArtifacts=true` and a public `MEMORY.md` artifact in the isolated workspace. Secrets and gateway tokens are not included in this PR body.
```

- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**
```sh
cd /media/vdb/code/ai/aispace/openclaw-worktrees/pr-91828
export OPENCLAW_HOME=/tmp/openclaw-pr91828-runtime-none/home
export OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR=/tmp/openclaw-pr91828-runtime-none/state
export OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH=/tmp/openclaw-pr91828-runtime-none/state/openclaw.json
export OPENCLAW_SKIP_CHANNELS=1

node scripts/run-node.mjs gateway call health --json --timeout 120000
node scripts/run-node.mjs gateway call wiki.status --json --timeout 120000
node scripts/run-node.mjs gateway call wiki.importInsights --json --timeout 120000
node scripts/run-node.mjs gateway call wiki.palace --json --timeout 120000

# After editing the live workspace MEMORY.md artifact, launch 6 concurrent gateway calls:
#   2 x wiki.status, 2 x wiki.importInsights, 2 x wiki.palace

# Then run 8 wiki.bridge.import calls while an external writer repeatedly replaces the generated bridge source page.
node scripts/run-node.mjs gateway call wiki.noSuchMethod --json --timeout 120000

NO_COLOR=1 FORCE_COLOR=0 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  extensions/memory-wiki/src/source-page-shared.test.ts \
  extensions/memory-wiki/src/source-sync.test.ts \
  extensions/memory-wiki/src/bridge.test.ts
```

- **Evidence after fix:**
```text
Gateway readiness:
2026-07-02T17:34:55.443+08:00 [gateway] http server listening (9 plugins: acpx, browser, canvas, device-pair, file-transfer, memory-core, memory-wiki, phone-control, talk-voice; 12.6s)
2026-07-02T17:34:55.641+08:00 [gateway] ready

runtime-gateway-calls-none-after-merge.txt:
- health: exit=0, memory-core and memory-wiki loaded, plugin errors=[]
- wiki.status: exit=0, vaultMode=bridge, bridgePublicArtifactCount=1, pageCounts.source=1, sourceCounts.bridge=1, warnings=[]
- wiki.importInsights: exit=0, totalItems=0, totalClusters=0, clusters=[]
- wiki.palace: exit=0, totalPages=10, pageCounts.source=1

runtime-gateway-concurrent-bridge-calls-after-merge.txt:
- six concurrent calls all exited 0:
  status_a wiki.status 0 810
  status_b wiki.status 0 810
  import_a wiki.importInsights 0 89
  import_b wiki.importInsights 0 89
  palace_a wiki.palace 0 242
  palace_b wiki.palace 0 242
- ingest_count_before=10
- ingest_count_after=11
- ingest_delta=1
- new ingest details: artifactCount=1, updatedCount=1, skippedCount=0, workspaces=1

runtime-gateway-path-mismatch-race-attempt-after-merge.txt:
- external writer repeatedly replaced /tmp/openclaw-pr91828-runtime-none/wiki/sources/bridge-workspace-b0b5d6b4-memory-2d62c497.md
- 8 x wiki.bridge.import exited 0
- final wiki.status: bridgePublicArtifactCount=1, pageCounts.source=1, sourceCounts.bridge=1, warnings=[]

runtime-gateway-path-mismatch-log-search-after-merge.txt:
- searched isolated gateway and memory-wiki logs for path-mismatch/FsSafeError/refusal/write retry signals
- match_count=0

runtime-gateway-negative-probe-after-merge.txt:
- wiki.noSuchMethod returned structured INVALID_REQUEST / unknown method and exited 1
- a follow-up wiki.status call exited 0 with bridgePublicArtifactCount=1, pageCounts.source=1, sourceCounts.bridge=1, warnings=[]

focused-vitest-after-merge.txt:
Test Files  3 passed (3)
Tests  22 passed (22)
Duration  21.98s
```

- **Observed result after fix:**
```text
`wiki.status`, `wiki.importInsights`, and `wiki.palace` all succeeded through the real `openclaw gateway call` surface against bridge-mode memory-wiki with one discovered public memory artifact and one generated bridge source page. After a live workspace artifact update, six concurrent gateway calls produced exactly one new bridge ingest log entry, showing that concurrent callers shared one bridge import/index-refresh pass for the same resolved config identity. The source-page rewrite pressure probe did not break imports or final status, and the adjacent unknown-method probe returned a structured gateway error instead of destabilizing the gateway. Focused memory-wiki regression tests also pass on the merge-resolved HEAD.
```

- **What was not tested:**
```text
The live rewrite-pressure probe did not emit a directly observable `path-mismatch`/`FsSafeError` log signal, so this proof does not claim a naturally observed path-mismatch recovery event. It proves the gateway stayed healthy under source-page rewrite pressure and that the focused regression suite covers the bounded retry path.

This proof does not rerun the reporter-scale ~1,900-file WSL2/RSS-pressure workload, external channel delivery, third-party provider/API behavior, or UI behavior.
```

- **Fix classification:** Root cause fix for the memory-wiki imported-source retry and bridge sync coalescing boundary.

## Review findings addressed

- **RF-001 [P1] exact-head real behavior proof for bridge gateway methods and retry/coalescing behavior:** Addressed for the real gateway surface on exact head `0aa26737dafd823a4d22d8e1046f8cb4780b2928`. `wiki.status`, `wiki.importInsights`, and `wiki.palace` all succeeded against bridge mode with a real public memory artifact; the concurrent six-call probe produced exactly one new ingest entry. Remaining gap: the live rewrite-pressure probe did not naturally surface a `path-mismatch` log/error signal, so that part is disclosed instead of overstated.
- **RF-002 [P1] live/local bridge proof gap:** Addressed with an isolated loopback OpenClaw gateway, memory-core + memory-wiki loaded, `vaultMode=bridge`, `bridge.readMemoryArtifacts=true`, and `bridgePublicArtifactCount=1` from an actual workspace `MEMORY.md` artifact.
- **RF-003 [P1] session-state / coalescing identity risk:** Addressed by the implementation and runtime probe. The coalescing key includes vault path/mode, bridge/ingest/render/search/context/obsidian config, and agent default/list workspace identity; the runtime concurrent batch updated the live artifact once and produced a single ingest delta across six gateway calls.
- **RF-004 [P1] stale gateway-load / reporter-scale proof:** Disclosed as unavailable in this environment. This update does not claim the reporter's ~1,900-file WSL2/RSS-pressure workload was rerun; it supplies exact-head local gateway proof for the memory-wiki bridge surface instead.
- **RF-005 [maintainer decision] merge-risk / canonical retry acceptance:** Still requires maintainer judgment. This merge keeps current main's shared `writeGuardedVaultPage` write boundary and keeps this PR focused on imported-source stat/read retry plus bridge import/index-refresh coalescing.
- **RF-006 [signal] fresh proof / re-review:** This update replaces stale pre-merge proof with current-head runtime gateway evidence and focused regression test results. The remaining proof gaps are explicitly listed in `What was not tested` rather than hidden behind tests.

## Competition / linked PR analysis

- ClawSweeper previously flagged overlap with #94443 on transient `path-mismatch` retry behavior.
- This conflict resolution uses the current main shared `writeGuardedVaultPage` retry behavior for the guarded write boundary and keeps this PR focused on imported-source stat/read retry plus bridge import/index-refresh coalescing.
- This avoids restoring a divergent direct write retry path, but it does not override the remaining maintainer choice about broad-vs-narrow canonical merge direction.

## Regression Test Plan

- **Target test command:** `NO_COLOR=1 FORCE_COLOR=0 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/memory-wiki/src/source-page-shared.test.ts extensions/memory-wiki/src/source-sync.test.ts extensions/memory-wiki/src/bridge.test.ts`
- **Result on current HEAD:** 3 test files passed, 22 tests passed.
- **Scenario locked in:** coalesced concurrent imported-source sync for identical bridge config, separate coalescing identity when workspace inputs differ, transient imported-source `path-mismatch` retry, preserved human Notes, and preserved symlink/path-alias + directory-collision refusal.
- **Why this is the smallest reliable guardrail:** these tests and the runtime gateway proof exercise the memory-wiki import/sync owner boundary that calls `syncImportedSourcesIfNeeded`; they avoid coupling the guardrail to unrelated channel delivery, provider routing, UI behavior, or external account state.

## Origin / follow-up

Existing PR tied to #91154. This update merges current local `origin/main` ref `04e4c3719de3c4e558fa62314861932d09e5778d`, resolves the source-page conflict, and revalidates exact head `0aa26737dafd823a4d22d8e1046f8cb4780b2928` through the local gateway surface.

## Merge risk

- **Risk labels considered:** `merge-risk: 🚨 session-state`, `extensions: memory-wiki`.
- **Risk explanation:** Behavior change is limited to memory-wiki import/sync coalescing and imported source-page retry; concurrent callers now share one underlying bridge import/index-refresh pass for the same resolved config identity.
- **Why acceptable:** The diff is confined to `extensions/memory-wiki`, coalescing identity includes the bridge artifact-discovery inputs that can change imported source results, and the runtime gateway proof shows repeated/concurrent bridge calls produce one consistent bridge source page and no warnings. Existing symlink/path-alias safety remains outside the retry path.
- **Remaining maintainer decision:** Accept whether this focused imported-source retry/coalescing patch is the desired canonical merge path alongside the broader guarded write behavior already present on main.

## Root Cause

- **Root cause:** Concurrent bridge imported-source syncs for the same vault/config each performed independent artifact-discovery + import/index-refresh passes, and imported source-page stat/read/write treated transient fs-safe `path-mismatch` races as fatal.
- **Why this is root-cause fix:** The fix coalesces at the import/sync source boundary, where bridge artifact discovery and index refresh are owned, and adds bounded retry only for the identified transient filesystem condition rather than masking downstream failures or weakening path safety.
- **Fix classification:** Root cause fix
- **Maintainer-ready confidence:** Medium-high: the exact-head gateway proof covers the bridge surface and concurrent coalescing behavior; confidence is bounded by the disclosed missing natural `path-mismatch` signal and missing reporter-scale WSL2/RSS workload.
- **Patch quality notes:** No skipped-test or lint suppression claims; no broad refactor. The catch/default paths are narrow guard behavior: `path-mismatch` is rethrown into the bounded retry loop, `not-file`/`hardlink` reads are treated as no preservable existing page content, and the actual write remains guarded by `writeGuardedVaultPage`, so symlink/path-alias safety is not masked.
- **Architecture / source-of-truth check:** Source-of-truth boundary: `source-sync.ts` and `bridge.ts` own bridge artifact discovery, import, and index refresh; `source-page-shared.ts` owns imported source-page retry; `writeGuardedVaultPage` remains the canonical guarded vault write contract from main. Gateway methods are callers of this owner path, not new contract owners.
